doctrine: Experience is a first-class asset. Reading docs or installing tools is not production experience.

professional_experience_capital.TOOL_ACCESS: can invoke relevant software or API
professional_experience_capital.OPERATIONAL_SKILL: can successfully perform bounded task on real artifacts
professional_experience_capital.PRODUCTION_EXPERIENCE: has performed task inside realistic product constraints
professional_experience_capital.CRITICAL_EXPERIENCE: has failed, diagnosed, repaired, and retained lesson
professional_experience_capital.MASTERED_CAPABILITY: produces consistently strong results across materially different contexts under independent review

experience_levels.E5: failed and repaired in real production
experience_levels.E7: repeatably produces professional-quality results under independent review

TIER_C: community discussion useful for discovery only
